pages.text: Once your class tree has 9 points, a $(l)Side Class$() tab opens next to it. Pick any other class there and spend up to 8 points on it. The tab has its own experience bar, filled by the same kills as your class tree.$(br2)Your side class can never be your main class.

Each side class offers its root, its first four tome spells, two upgrades for each, and four early passives. You can learn $(l)two$() of the four spells; you cast them with any weapon.$(br2)Arrow spells still need a bow, and caster spells still use runes. Tier-4 spells, Mastery and weapon talents stay with your main class.
